scope: Once per battle, before any submission, opening-only world-averaged one-joint-turn search. Every later request uses the same frozen F32 nonlinear policy. All three F32 final nonlinear checkpoints are retained; no checkpoint or seed selection.
hypotheses: Fresh official-generator training-partition teams, considering each cyclic lead rotation, accepting only exact equality of the entire projected opening: own request, public messages since start, and player features except request counters. This rotated-team prior is misspecified, is not the official conditional posterior, and is not calibrated. Includes generated Illusion candidates only when their projected appearance and messages match. Fitted own sets reproduce private stats; no hidden live state is read. If two accepted hypotheses are not found within 512 generated teams, retain the base action and count the fallback.
search_estimator: Enumerate every live legal root action in each of two accepted hypothetical worlds. Sample one frozen-model opponent action per world before seeing any candidate; reuse it across candidates. Same initial surrogate chance seed across candidates is a paired schedule, not aligned random events or independent samples. Resolve intermediate requests with frozen policies for at most16 requests until terminal or a fresh joint move boundary at turn>=2. Backup exact terminal reward else frozen own value. Softmax(log prior+mean backup/0.1), sample once. Root search RNG depends only on the complete allowed input, model seed, and fixed F33 namespace, never the live mechanics/team seeds or opponent identity.
audit: For each checkpoint, four fixed independent development openings, every legal learner root action, two frozen-policy continuation RNG replicates. The real simulator supplies labels only to the offline audit. Opponent root choice is fixed across candidate actions within a replicate and comes from its own player projection. After completing the first joint turn, record the own frozen value on that fixed successor and continue both frozen policies to terminal or120turn cutoff. Report terminal-only MSE versus0.5 and constant base rate, within-opening action ranking/concordance and root-value versus empirical rollout-return ranking. The two replicates share initial mechanics, are not independent worlds, and are too small for a calibrated action-value claim. These audit outcomes do not tune the search or select checkpoints.
gates: Scientific pilot benefit requires each seed tactical cutoff-aware point gain>=.02 and adjusted bootstrap lower>0, no detected random/base-power regression, cutoff rates<=.05, plus no correctness failures. Report all nine dependent schedule contrasts. Small opening-only intervention and32pairs/cell are underpowered; inconclusive is allowed and does not justify extending the run. Hypothesis/branch budget fallbacks are normal counted outcomes. Transport/schema/replay/source failures abort and preserve evidence without repair/restart.
limits: No arbitrary-position reconstruction, deeper search, equilibrium or exploitability claim. Two-world estimates are noisy. Frozen self-model opponent differs from evaluation heuristics. Synthetic leaf observations are schema-compatible, not proven in distribution. Fresh development games against familiar opponents and recurring generation do not establish held-out or public strength. G2/G3/G4/G5 remain open. Exhaustive replay doubles physical execution, not the scientific sample size. No new training. No automatic next experiment.
